themes.description: Users are experiencing various bugs, feature removals, and performance issues that are leading to frustration and disappointment. Key concerns include the loss of order history, inability to filter orders, and problems with equity and P&L calculations.
themes.business_impact: The app's functionality issues and disappointments are leading to user dissatisfaction, potential loss of business, and damage to the product's reputation.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of these issues likely stems from inadequate testing, prioritization of feature additions over bug fixes, and a lack of communication between teams.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct thorough reviews of app functionality and user feedback
• Identify and prioritize high-priority bug fixes and feature enhancements
• Improve communication between teams to ensure better testing and development practices
• Develop a user-centric approach to prioritize user needs and satisfaction
• Provide clear and timely updates to users regarding app updates and feature changes.

Worst customer support experience. Whenever you raise an issue, each support ticket takes 2–3 months, and even then, there's no resolution.
There customer support sucks, they have created some random chatbot which neither gives correct answer nor raise it to real people, it's going in a loop, very frustrating

themes.description: Users are frustrated with the slow and ineffective customer support, causing them to experience difficulties in resolving their issues.
themes.business_impact: High ticket escalation and resolution time, leading to negative word-of-mouth and potential loss of customers.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient investment in human customer support agents and inadequate technology to handle volume and complexity of tickets.
themes.action_plan:
• Hire more human customer support agents
• Invest in automation technology to streamline ticket resolution
• Implement a callback mechanism for high-priority issues
